structuralHypothesis: Widened the recognised BIR instrument vocabulary (RMC, RMO, RDO, PAN, FLD, FAN, FDDA, BOC, CTA, ATP, COR, TIN) so an explanatory request over one of them in explicit BIR context is a definition rather than an ordinary action. A Filipino/Taglish tax predicate governing a named object is a governed tax relation. An ordinary creative or selection action over an artefact governs its own target, so a tax-shaped modifier on a paint shade or icon creates no tax jurisdiction.
